info.title: SDKWork Account Backend API
info.description: Backend wallet write commands and operational health for integrators.

post.description: Claims a batch of pending acct_outbox_event rows, marks them PUBLISHED, and returns payloads for downstream relay workers.
Creates a cash ledger adjustment. `assetType` is forced to `cash`.
Creates a points ledger adjustment and applies FIFO lot movement.
Sweeps expired points lots, debits account balances, and writes ledger plus allocation rows.
Checks points accounts for lot remaining vs available mismatches.
Creates a hold moving balance from available to frozen.
Sweeps expired holds and restores frozen balance to available.
Atomically transfers available balance between two accounts of the same asset type.
Credits Token Bank balance after governed purchase, issuance, or service income.
Debits Token Bank balance for direct AI consumption or burn.
Credits Token Bank balance for platform, subscription, compensation, or campaign grants.
Appends a Token Bank reversal ledger entry for a previous movement.
Creates a Token Bank hold moving balance from available to frozen.
Settles a Token Bank hold after final metered usage.
Releases unused or failed-task Token Bank hold balance.
Transfers Token Bank balance between accounts of the same asset type.

get.description: Lists stored account billing policies for the operator surface.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization scope to list; omitted means the tenant scope.

post.description: Stores the next revision of a billing policy for one (scope, priority); the previous live revision is retired in the same transaction.
Enables a stored billing policy revision.
Retires a stored billing policy revision and frees its scope slot.

get.description: Resolves the policy governing a subject. A null item means no stored row applies and the documented platform defaults govern it.

parameters.name: ownerUserId
parameters.description: Subject whose funding policy is resolved.

parameters.name: apiKeyId
parameters.description: API key issuing the call, when the caller is a key.

post.description: Answers what the account side would decide for a hypothetical charge without creating a hold. This is the operator simulate primitive and the routing runtime read-only diagnostic.

get.description: Lists the wallet accounts of one owner with available, frozen and pending amounts.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization scope of the wallet; omitted means the tenant scope.

parameters.name: ownerUserId
parameters.description: Wallet owner; omitted means the authenticated operator.

get.description: Lists ledger entries of one wallet owner, most recent first.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization scope of the wallet; omitted means the tenant scope.

parameters.name: ownerUserId
parameters.description: Wallet owner; omitted means the authenticated operator.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Keyset cursor for the next page.

get.description: Lists the allowance points lots of one wallet owner, including remaining amount and expiry.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization scope of the wallet; omitted means the tenant scope.

parameters.name: ownerUserId
parameters.description: Wallet owner; omitted means the authenticated operator.

businessType.description: Lowercase snake_case ledger business type (validated by CommerceLedgerBusinessType).

expiresAt.description: Optional points lot expiry for credit adjustments.

reversedLedgerId.description: Optional original ledger entry id when posting a compensating adjustment.

ownerUserId.description: Optional scope filter; when set only lots owned by this user are swept.

accountId.description: Optional scope filter; when set only lots for this account are swept.

businessType.description: Lowercase snake_case ledger business type (validated by CommerceLedgerBusinessType).

expiresAt.description: Optional points lot expiry for credit adjustments.

reversedLedgerId.description: Optional original ledger entry id when posting a compensating adjustment.

businessType.description: Lowercase snake_case ledger business type (validated by CommerceLedgerBusinessType).

expiresAt.description: Optional points lot expiry for credit adjustments.

reversedLedgerId.description: Optional original ledger entry id when posting a compensating adjustment.

scopeType.description: 0 platform, 1 tenant, 2 organization, 3 user, 4 api key.

revision.description: Revision number of this scope policy.

prechargeRatio.description: Decimal multiplier applied to the estimated charge.

outputTokenCeiling.description: Ceiling applied to a client-declared output-token cap.

minHoldPoints.description: Lowest reservation raised for a positive estimate.

maxHoldShare.description: Largest share of the wallet one reservation may freeze.

creditLimitPoints.description: Credit line available to credit modes.

allowanceQuota.description: Period allowance quota, when the mode uses one.

pageInfo.description: Page info field on the billing policy list response.

scopeId.description: Owner id of the scope; 0 for the platform default.

holdPoints.description: Amount the account side would freeze, in points.

estimatedPoints.description: Estimated charge for the hypothetical request, in token-bank points.

version.description: Optimistic version of the account row.

remainingAmount.description: Points still spendable in this lot.
